newsitem.title: USA: Value Health sees MedView deal closed soon.
newsitem.headline: Value Health sees MedView deal closed soon.

text.p: Value Health Inc said on Thursday it expected to complete its acquisition of Beverly Enterprises Inc's MedView Services Inc unit by the end of November.
The companies said in October they signed a definitive agreement on the $87.5 million cash transaction.
On Thursday Value Health said it received early termination from the Federal Trade Commission of its Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period relating to the MedView Services deal.
MedView is a provider of workers' compensation managed care services that Value Health said it plans to combine with its Community Care Network operations.
